description: T04-A metadata evidence-gap slice of issue #83: an isolated policy enables only ddl.alter.modify_column.compatibility.require (blocker, required, requires_metadata). Offline MODIFY COLUMN emits a statement evidence gap (missing_source_column) and unverified coverage at warning-equivalent fail-on weight; the same statement audited against the pinned MySQL 8.4.10 fixture proves metadata-backed pass and reject paths with post-verify evidence that the product never executed the submitted ALTER. The locked four-anchor db baseline and the T03 CLI denominator are preserved verbatim; mysql-alter-modify-column-position additionally pins gap+incomplete coexistence. This is the T04-A slice only — target-version/capability work stays deferred to T04-B.
